segment_summary.zh: 从客厅中央沿房间向前接近窗前和窗帘，随后靠近右侧电视柜，最终停在可同时看到两处门洞的位置；画面左侧为电视，机器人尚未穿过左侧门洞。
segment_summary.en: From the center of the living room, the robot moved forward toward the window and curtain, then approached the TV console on the right, and finally stopped at a position facing two doorways; the TV is on the left of the view, and the robot has not passed through the left doorway.

reason.zh: 这些帧显示机器人仍在同一客厅内活动：先经过左侧沙发与右侧电视柜，后续画面转到两个门洞前；没有证据表明它已进入错误房间或穿过左侧门洞，因此本段与客厅段及面向两门洞的当前要求相符。卧室内的电视在左、床在右以及到远端窗前停止尚未完成。
reason.en: These frames show the robot still moving within the same living room: it first passed the couch on the left and the TV console on the right, and later faced the two doorways. There is no evidence that it entered a wrong room or passed through the left doorway, so this segment is consistent with the living-room stage and the current requirement to face the two doorways. The bedroom requirements of keeping the TV on the left, the bed on the right, and stopping at the far window have not yet been completed.

segment_summary.zh: 从客厅视角出发，先经过一段白墙或门框的近景，视野几乎被白色表面占满；随后短暂出现一个带远端窗户、左侧床和床头柜的卧室画面；到 B 处又回到客厅视角，还是面向原来的左侧门洞和远处餐区，左侧仍是同一台山景电视。
segment_summary.en: Starting from the living-room viewpoint, the robot passed a stretch of close-up white wall/door-frame views that nearly filled the frame; a bedroom with a far window, a bed and a nightstand on the left briefly appeared; at B the view returned to the living room, again facing the original left doorway and the dining area beyond, with the same mountain-scene TV on the left.

reason.zh: 任务要求穿过左侧门洞进入卧室，保持电视在左、床在右，一路向前并在卧室最远端窗前停下；但 B 处的画面（电视在左侧、白扶手椅、远处餐桌、左侧带粉色窗帘的门洞）与 A 处客厅视角基本一致，说明机器人在短暂进入卧室后又退回到客厅，没有停在卧室远端窗前，通行行为与任务要求冲突。
reason.en: The task requires going through the left doorway into the bedroom, keeping the TV on the left and the bed on the right, walking straight to the far end and stopping in front of the window; however, the view at B (TV on the left, white armchair, dining table beyond, pink-curtained doorway on the left) essentially matches the living-room view at A, showing that after briefly entering the bedroom the robot retreated back into the living room instead of stopping in front of the far window, which conflicts with the task.
